name: – Bogdan Rzońca – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Union Solidarity Fund to provide assistance to Romania regarding the floods at the end of May 2025, Cyprus following the wildfires in July 2025 and Spain following the wildfires in August 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament approves giving money from the European Union Solidarity Fund to three countries hit by natural disasters in 2025. Romania gets about 14.3 million euro after floods, Cyprus about 9.2 million euro after wildfires, and Spain about 120.6 million euro after wildfires. The fund helps countries cope with major damage. The report also asks for faster payments and better preparation for climate risks.

- Romania, Cyprus and Spain receive 144.1 million euro in total for disaster recovery.
- People, businesses and local areas hit by floods and fires benefit.
- Parliament leaders sign the decision; the money is then paid out.
